capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Subaru USA 2027 press kit: "Powered by a 74.7-kWh high-capacity lithium-ion battery".

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 71.0 kWh usable for the 74.7 kWh pack (bZ4X Touring AWD MY26); same pack in the Subaru twin of the bZ/C-HR (Subaru US releases state 74.7 kWh).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Same 74.7 kWh pack as the 2026 bZ (Subaru US release), whose chief engineer says the pack keeps the same NMC chemistry and cells (Autopian).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 391 V for the 74.7 kWh pack; Toyota chief engineer (InsideEVs) says 400-volt architecture; the Subaru twin uses the 74.7 kWh pack.

preconditioning.notes: Onboard battery-preconditioning system, "enabled either by navigating to a charging destination or by the driver via touchscreen controls".

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Subaru does not state the Trailseeker onboard charger; the Uncharted release (same platform, Subaru twin of the Toyota bZ Woodland) states 11 kW, as does the Woodland (Toyota Canada).

dc_max_kw.notes: "speeds up to 150 kW on a DC-fast charger".

published_10_80_min.notes: "can charge from 10% to 80% in as little as 28 minutes".
